video_title: How Muggsy Bogues Helped Shape Vince Carter & Tracy McGrady In Toronto

quotes.speaker: Muggsy Bogues
quotes.summary_phrase: Muggsy Bogues explains his decision to join the Toronto Raptors
quotes.excerpt: all I needed was finishers. Guys who love to run up and down the floor
quotes.quote: I had no idea that I was going to be coming to Toronto till Butch Carter, who was our coach back then, came and recruited me and Dell Curry to come. It was on the down end of my career at the time, but I knew of you guys. Seeing what you guys were capable of, you two were the main reason why I decided to come, because all I needed was finishers. Guys who love to run up and down the floor, who get up, and I could throw the ball wherever I wanted in the air and y'all were going to catch it.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Tracy McGrady on the importance of veteran leadership for young players
quotes.excerpt: it's important to have those vets to teach you how to be a pro.
quotes.quote: We tell the story all the time about how important the vets were for us at a young age. I came in at 18, and for me, you come in out of high school, you don't know anything about this game. There is so much you have to juggle, finances. I'm a kid that signed a $12 million shoe contract and then I get drafted, I'm a lottery pick. So there is so much that I'm juggling, and at that point, I think it's important to have those vets to teach you how to be a pro.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: Vince Carter reflects on the guidance provided by veteran teammates
quotes.excerpt: We had you guys to help us, mold us, and put us in the direction
quotes.quote: We were fortunate. I don't think I know for a fact you didn't, and I know I didn't either, we didn't realize how lucky we had it as far as each and every day we had a vet that you played with. LJ, who was a superstar, you were a star yourself. We had you guys to help us, mold us, and put us in the direction of, 'Now young fella, that's not the way to go.' We had multiple guys to do that.

quotes.speaker: Muggsy Bogues
quotes.summary_phrase: Muggsy Bogues on the 1999-2000 Toronto Raptors playoff team
quotes.excerpt: It was the first year that the Toronto made the playoffs, being in the league for five years.
quotes.quote: That season with us, that was a fun season with AD, Muggsy, you, Dell, D-Brown, K-Willis, Oak, Doug Christie. That was a fun year. It was the first year that the Toronto made the playoffs, being in the league for five years. But it was you two. We knew what you two were. We just had to be a supporting cast. We knew what you two were, we just had to be a supporting cast.

quotes.speaker: Muggsy Bogues
quotes.summary_phrase: Muggsy Bogues on managing egos and team chemistry
quotes.excerpt: Once we let them know who they truly are and we ain't have no ill feelings about that.
quotes.quote: It was more so, we just got to get them to understand who they are. Once we let them know who they truly are and we ain't have no ill feelings about that and let them be who they are, we knew we can keep climbing up the ladder. All of us were on pretty much the down side of our careers, myself, Dell, Oak, Antonio, Kevin Willis, D-Brown, all of us. But we understood what you two were and what you meant to the team and what you meant to the franchise.

quotes.speaker: Muggsy Bogues
quotes.summary_phrase: Muggsy Bogues on the potential of Carter and McGrady
quotes.excerpt: I've seen talent my entire career and what it is and what it can become.
quotes.quote: I've seen talent my entire career and what it is and what it can become. Like I said, it was like the LJ and Zo. When they first came in, I knew what they was capable of, they just need to understand who they were. Where we also separate the egos, to where we all blend in as one. And people think that they had this beef, they ain't had no beef, they played great together and they understood and they liked one another.
